title: dimocarpus confinis
intro: Dimocarpus confinis, commonly known as the Borneo jackfruit, is a species of fruit-bearing tree that belongs to the Anacardiaceae family. The plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of Dimocarpus confinis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress and infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
